content: वेदिः [विद्-इन्] A learned man, sage; Paṇḍita. .{@-दिः, -दी@} {%f.%} .²1 An altar, especially one prepared for a sacrifice; उर एव वेदिः <ls>Ch. Up. 5. 18. 2</ls>; अमी वेदि परितः कॢप्तधिष्ण्याः (वह्नयः) <ls>Ś. 4. 8</ls>. .²2 An altar of a particular shape, the middle points of which come very close to each other; मध्येन सा वेदिविलग्नमध्या <ls>Ku. 1. 39</ls>; (some propose to take वेदि in this passage as meaning ‘a seal-ring’). .²3 A quadrangular spot in the court-yard of a temple or palace; विमानं नवमुद्वेदि चतुःस्तम्भप्रतिष्ठितम् (कल्पयामासुः) <ls>R. 17. 9</ls>. .²4 A seal-ring. .²5 <ab>N.</ab> of Sarasvatī. .²6 A tract or region.
